svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Box 750 long, 140 wide, 150 high, open on top for the hatch.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two sides and the floor from 3 mm lite-ply; firewall and rear wall from 6 mm birch ply.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 3 mm bulkheads 252 and 585 back from the firewall face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6 mm doublers inside each side, 200 x 52, top edge 3 below the rim.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the joiner hole 20.5 through side and doubler, centre 420 back and 20 down from the rim.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the wing bolt hole 5.5, centre 544 back and 21 down; same on both sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the rear wall 20.5 for the tail boom, 45 down from the rim, on the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Glue on a flat board with a square; check both joiner holes line up with a straight 20 mm rod.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Glass the outside with 80 g/m2 cloth; four M4 inserts in the floor for the payload mount.
